fixes_deliberately_not_made: The NOTE-vs-DECISION keying mismatch. Three repairs exist (change add_memory's default type / widen recall's scope / route the operator to synapse_decide) with different blast radii. That is a product decision, not a defect with one obvious repair - escalated, not guessed.

Ordering get_by_type one layer down in both backends. Closer to the cause and would fix every consumer, but it changes a broadly-consumed accessor's contract across two files and three call sites, and the evidence does not force choosing it over the recall-site fix.

Relaxing the containment match (punctuation strip, token overlap, embedding). A recall/precision tradeoff that overlaps directly with M6's 'exact-match table first' shape and should be ruled WITH M6, not ahead of it.

seam_C.why_no_fix: Brief: 'If the fault is here, the fix is design, not code.' Seam C is two missing MECHANISMS (an address and a capture direction), not a broken one. M6 is HELD; model-in-loop determinism is prohibited; no new fixtures. Design note written, nothing built.

repro_test_detail.restart_fidelity: Genuine fresh OS processes via subprocess + sys.executable; process 1 exits before process 2 starts. Both shutdown shapes tested: graceful sys.exit(0) (atexit -> save) and abrupt os._exit(0) (no atexit, the crash class). Two objects in one interpreter is never presented as a restart.
repro_test_detail.production_path: Every deposit and recall goes through the real command handlers the MCP tools bind to (synapse_decide -> handle_memory_decide, synapse_add_memory -> handle_memory_add, synapse_recall -> handle_memory_recall). Only the websocket transport is skipped, and it only marshals the same payload dict.
repro_test_detail.safety_interlock: test_store_address_is_redirected_into_tmp runs FIRST and proves the child's store is inside tmp and NOT under ~/.synapse. If the headless address resolver ever stops honouring CWD, that test goes red before any test writes.
repro_test_detail.law_1_note: One assertion in this leg was caught VACUOUS by its own negative control and fixed forward: test_recall_survives_an_unrelated_prune originally deposited all 12 decisions before any note, so swap-and-pop only ever back-filled notes with notes and the decision order never moved - it passed with FIX-B1 reverted. Interleaving the deposits (note/decision, ending on a decision) made it discriminate. Recorded because the near-miss is the point of Law 1.
repro_test_detail.houdini_coverage: NONE, honestly. Houdini is not running; no hython test was run and no mock hou was planted.

The repro currently PINS present behaviour green, so whichever is chosen turns that pin red deliberately. Not guessed, not fixed.

THE LOAD-PATH DEFECT (embedder dim mismatch). Three SYNAPSE-local remedies, none touching fsync posture: (a) persist embedder id/dim beside the snapshot and refuse-or-re-embed on mismatch; (b) PIN THE EMBEDDER for a store once written - smallest, and demonstrated sufficient to recover all 355 rows; (c) extend _quarantine_if_corrupt from 'is the JSON well-formed' to 'can this store actually be opened'.

R-CI0-1 A vs B, reframed by two new facts: (i) option A is not a guarantee but an ARTEFACT OF THE MONOTONIC CLOCK EPOCH (measured 100701.77 at process start) - on a process launched within 30 s of boot A silently becomes B; (ii) the loss observed in production is deposit #2, not deposit #1, so choosing B makes the observed loss STRICTLY LARGER while A leaves it where it is. Neither option touches the load-path fault. Posture unchanged by this leg.

SHOULD A FAILED BACKEND BE ALLOWED TO SERVE SILENTLY AT ALL? _make_store swallows any construction failure and returns an empty MemoryStore while the panel keeps accepting 'remember this'. That single choice is what converted FIVE separate defects into one invisible symptom. Options: keep the silent fallback, surface it in the panel, or make an unservable requested backend a hard startup error.

WAL POISON - three candidate targets with different owners: (a) stop sending non-UUID keys at moneta_store.py:494 (SYNAPSE-local, smallest); (b) harden wal_read at moneta/durability.py:170 (UPSTREAM Moneta, separate release train); (c) extend quarantine to wal.log (SYNAPSE-local). Also: the docstrings at moneta_store.py:176-180/:265-270/:302 still assert the WAL is inert because 'SYNAPSE never calls signal_attention', which line 495 does on every text search. That stale contract is why nobody looked.

escalations.urgency: must be ruled in the same breath as M6
escalations.item: REGISTRATION POSTURE. synapse_apply_fixture is absent from TOOL_DEFS (123) and the panel toolset (129). A phrase table alone would still leave it unadvertised. Does the engine enter as a MODEL-CALLABLE TOOL (model may decline - sameness likely, not guaranteed) or as a PRE-MODEL INTERCEPTION (prompt resolved before the model is invoked - sameness guaranteed)? Opposite failure modes; only the second delivers the reported ask.

FIX-B1 buys DETERMINISM, not RELEVANCE: created_at is second-resolution, so within a burst of deposits the ordering falls through entirely to id asc, a content hash. Deterministic, stable across restarts and prunes, and semantically arbitrary. Ranking recall properly means giving it a score, which is not a small change and is not forced by this evidence. Confirm determinism-without-relevance is the right thing to ship now.

residual_unknowns: Does Python's atexit actually fire on a Houdini 22 shutdown? Every 'clean exit persists' green here came from sys.exit(0) in a bare interpreter. EXPERIMENT: deposit through hython, quit once via hou.exit() and once by closing the window, check snapshot.json mtime each time. If atexit does not run, the graceful column collapses into the abrupt one and the 30 s window applies to EVERY deposit, not just #2..n. Does not change any verdict; bounds how much worse seam A gets.

Which tool Joe actually used to 'remember' - synapse_add_memory (NOTE, unrecallable), synapse_decide (DECISION, recallable), or synapse_memory_write (a different markdown subsystem). The log evidence points at add_memory/NOTE, but his session transcript would settle it. TRAP ON FILE: ~/.synapse/logs/synapse.log contains pytest-authored records; fingerprint them out before trusting the log as production evidence.

Which surface Joe was on - synapse_chat.pypanel (route_chat, builds nothing), synapse_panel.pypanel (ClaudeWorker, builds via a model turn), or external MCP. Seam C is FAULTY on all three so no verdict is blocked, but the demo, the repro and the eventual fix differ per surface.

Which embedder Houdini's Python 3.13.10 seat resolves. The children here ran under 3.14.2 where SemanticEmbedder (dim 384) succeeds. If the Houdini seat falls back to HashEmbedder while an out-of-process tool does not (or vice versa), that is another route into the identical silent empty-jsonl fallback.

Whether Joe's real store has crossed the n>1000 / every-100th-add threshold that fires the automatic sleep pass, or whether he has ever invoked synapse_sleep_pass - decides whether the prune-permutation mode has actually bitten him rather than merely being reachable.
